title: Learn the basics of Google Antigravity
summary: Google's official Antigravity walkthrough: agent manager, editor and browser agent, artifacts (plans, task lists, walkthroughs).

assertions.quote: a walkthrough ... communicate what it did as well as some of the verification steps ... screenshots

verdicts.note: Review is the measured bottleneck (DORA, Faros); tooling that speeds verification directly addresses it.

assertions.quote: an implementation plan ... prior to actually going off and making changes

verdicts.note: Plan-then-execute consistently reduces agent rework in practice and in vendor evals, especially on multi-file tasks.

assertions.quote: it can actually test the code that it just wrote all on its own

verdicts.note: Agent benchmarks and practice consistently show verifiable feedback (tests, compilers) is the main driver of agent success.

assertions.quote: you can have the agent do work for you in the background while you focus on maybe a more complex task in the foreground

verdicts.note: Review and merge overhead limits parallel agents for most people today, but structured setups (worktrees, independent tasks) are productive for some.
